info.title: Enterprise Multimodal RAG
info.description:
Answers questions over corporate documents with citations that are verified
against the source text before they are returned.

Every claim carries at least one citation naming the document, page, chunk id,
bounding region and a quote that provably appears in that chunk. When the corpus
does not support an answer the response status is `not_found` rather than prose.

get.description: Return immediately; used by the container health check.
Report whether models are warm, the vector store is reachable and the registry synced.
Report versions, the active backend and the routable models.

post.description: Answer a question, returning only claims with verified citations.

post.summary: Answer a question as a server-sent event stream
post.description: Stream an answer, then emit verified citations and any revision.
Return ranked passages with their text, scores and page links.

Validate and accept a document for ingestion.

Short native PDFs are ingested inline as a background task; anything larger,
scanned or mixed is queued in the inbox for the full Colab pipeline. Re-
uploading identical bytes is idempotent: the existing document is returned.

get.description: List the tenant's documents, newest first.
Return one document's full record, including its quality report.

delete.description: Delete a document's vectors, artifacts and registry entry.

get.description: Return a page preview as WebP, with an optional highlight rectangle.
Return the raw image behind a figure citation.
Page through a document's chunks, for debugging and source browsing.
Return one ingestion or deletion job, scoped to the caller's tenant.
Return the quota ledger snapshot for every routable model.
Return a single chunk by id, for citation inspection.
